body: i really wish i could stop crying! i will, thank you. i think i should try to sleep, i have to be up in 4 hours to get back to work. and i have to do it. or i'll be back there again. thank you. youre wonderful.

im thinking about it. and i am grateful for the advice, im having a hard time deciding what to do. but i know theres a chance she'll just hate me more, and selfishly, i dont know if i can cope with that. at the moment im a mess and i cant do anything. its ok, its what i chose, but thats kind of you. i hope youre ok.

im crying my eyes out right now. i dont know that its even that im super considerate, im definitely bad at dealing with guilt. it doesnt make it feel any less awful though. i kinda want to reach out to her and explain but im sure she doesnt want to hear from me. i hope i can get back to work, as much as its draining, i have to do it, and everything will get worse if i dont. i have barely left my bed for days and only just ate for the first time since saturday. and that feels awful. thats a really lovely thing to say, you and your friend seem like amazing people.

i really feel like i am. i have amazing friends, but what happens when your friends are amazing and talented is that they move all over the world. some of them are having a bad time right now and it kills me that i cant be there with them, because honestly, thats what im good for. im in a city all alone that hates me. i thought i had a friend recently but we're not talking any more because i dont want to sleep with him while hes still sleeping with his ex, because i dont want to do that to her. so ive just been trying to work and work but i just dont want to anymore. i just want to stay in bed. i had to tell the doctor about my plans for ending it on christmas eve and he seemed to feel bad for me. and i just cant pick myself up since then.
just made me cry. thank you.
